description: Equinix, Inc. is the world's digital infrastructure company, shortening the path to boundless connectivity anywhere in the world to enable the innovations that enrich work, life and planet. It combines a global footprint of International Business Exchange and xScale data centers in the Americas, Asia-Pacific, and Europe, the Middle East and Africa regions, infrastructure and interconnection offerings, and digital ecosystems required to serve a large and diverse set of customers around the world. Incorporated on June 22, 1998 as a Delaware corporation and operating as a REIT for federal income tax purposes, it has been a network-neutral, multi-tenant data center provider since its inception, where competing networks could connect and share data traffic.
